The Council of Nordiheim and their diplomats are glad to announce the signing of a trade and resource deal with the Commonwealth of [nation]Gythena[/nation].

This deal will allow both nations access to resources of importance for both nations aswell as open their two markets to eachother for the trade of goods and services.

[spoiler=Nordiheimian and Gythenan Trade and Resource deal of 12th of September 2025]
[b]Trade deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Commonwealth of Gythena[/b]
[i]====================================================[/i]

[i][u]With this deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Gythena agree to adhere to the following points:[/u][/i]
[i][u]_T_______________R_______________A_______________D_______________E_______________!_[/u][/i]
[u][b]Resource Section.[/b][/u]

[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim agrees to open its markets of [b]Iron[/b] and [b]Aluminium[/b] to Gythena for it to buy these resources as needed.

[u][b]1.b:[/b][/u] Gythena agrees to open its markets of [b]Gas[/b] and [b]Phosphoros[/b] to Nordiheim for it to buy these resources as needed.

[b][u]1.c:[/u][/b] The quanteties of these resources will be ordered and delivered on a quarterly bassis.

[u][b]1.d:[/b][/u] The values of these resources will be based on world market prices on a quarterly bassis.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++
[u][b]Trade Section.[/b][/u]

[u][b]2.a:[/b][/u] Both nations markets shall become open to each other for the flow and trade of general goods, luxury goods and services to encourage economic growth and prosperity.

[u][b]2.b:[/b][/u] This will allow Nordiheim to buy from Gythenas quality lumber, alcohols and meats.

[b][u]2.c:[/u][/b] This will allow Gythena to buy from Nordiheims large range of exotic fruits & berries, steel products and precious stones.

[b][u]2.d:[/u][/b] Neither nation are allowed to place tarifs or special taxes on goods or services from the other nation without both nations coming together to discuss and reach a mutual agreement of understanding and consent.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

[b][u]3:[/u][/b] In the interest of friendship and co-operation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Gythena be open to change and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nation or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of the deal between the two nations as long as both parties can arrive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------++++++

[i]Signatory parties[/i]

[u][i]The Council of The United Regions of Nordiheim[/i][/u] _______________________________________ [u][i]Prime Minister Gabriel Holder of The Commonwealth of Gythena[/i][/u][/spoiler]

Economic experts belive this deal will encourage growth in both nations economies and industry as it takes effect.
